'''Flies''' are a {{type|Bug}} [[enemy]] that can be found in many [[Chapters]].

== Behavior ==
Melee attacker that tries to get closer to its enemies. Moves in a simple way, meaning it will not account for hazards (such as {{tile|Fire}}).

Has permament {{st|Flying}}.

=== Tips ===
* Due to their low damage, one can be somewhat safely kept alive towards the end of combat to farm [[Trash Bag|trash bags]] or gather [[pickups]].
* As 1-hp enemies, they can easily be taken out with a cat with {{p|Tower Defense}}.

== Notes ==
* Does not have a back to activate backstab effects.
* Does not leave a corpse.

== Trivia ==
* Flies bear a similar appearance to the {{tboi|Fly|Flies}} found in ''The Binding of Isaac''.
* Fly is the earliest encounterable enemy that is also present in {{ch|The Rift}}.
